source.title: Call for Applicants - WRC Leader (September 2020)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Regulations Leader, as Lucas Garron’s term is ending as the Leader of the WCA Regulations Committee. We would like to thank Lucas for the work he has done leading the committee.


Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

- Strong leadership skills
- Attention to detail
- Expert knowledge of Regulations
- Analytical thinking
- Excellent communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from **now until October 26th, 2020, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

<!-- break -->

**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

1. Brief personal introduction.
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
3. Ambitions as the WRC Leader of the WCA.


Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.


The rights and duties of the WRC can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2017.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.2%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf).


After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2020.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).


Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会负责人招募（2020 年 9 月）
translation.content:
Lucas Garron 担任 WCA 规则委员会负责人的任期即将结束，WCA 将任命新的负责人。感谢 Lucas 在领导委员会期间所做的工作。

候选人须能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周至少投入 5 小时处理委员会工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

- 出色的领导能力。
- 注重细节。
- 精通竞赛规则。
- 善于分析问题。
- 出色的沟通能力。

申请时间为**即日起至 2020 年 10 月 26 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：**

1. 简短的个人介绍。
2. 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
3. 担任 WCA 规则委员会负责人后的工作设想。

申请者还须提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WRC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2017.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.2%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将按照 [WCA 动议 10.2020.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节的规定投票选定人选，经高级代表及现任委员会／团队负责人投票确认后，公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
